content_blocks.label: clause_1._Premises
content_blocks.text: The Landlord hereby leases to the Tenant, and the Tenant hereby rents from the Landlord, the premises located at 123 Main Street, Springfield Township.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Term
content_blocks.text: The term of this lease shall commence on April 1, 2024, and end on March 31, 2029, unless terminated earlier as provided herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_3.2_Rent
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay rent in the amount of $5,000 per month, payable on the first day of each month, commencing on April 1, 2024.
